_comment: Marginal best-ball utility (src/bestball/marginal.py). Every value here is a declared PRIOR, not a fitted or validated constant. paramSetId is a content hash computed at load time over the non-underscore keys (src/bestball/params.py), so editing a value mints a new id.
_draws: Inherited from src.roster_intel.best_ball_utility.DEFAULT_DRAWS (pinned equal by test). Raising it tightens mc_standard_error only; it never moves the materiality band.
_candidatesPerSlotFamily: How many top-by-ppg priced free agents are offered per slot family the removed player can fill. The exact lineup re-solve picks among the offered candidates; this cap only bounds cost.
_materialityPpg: Reference band in expected best-ball points per week. Used alone while predictive_basis is 'unavailable'. Not a significance threshold and not a probability.
_testDraws: Draw count for fast structural tests. Never used by a published number.
